description: Get the full transcript of a public YouTube video as plain text with timestamped segments and its caption languages. Summarize, search or quote any video. Use it when: You need to summarize, quote or search what is said in a video. Not for: Videos with no captions at all; the call fails and you are not charged. Returns: Language, full transcript text, timestamped segments, video length and the other caption languages available. Typical time: about 7 s. Price: $0.005 per video, charged only on success. One call = one video transcript.

language.description: Caption language code, e.g. en, de, es; default en

name: youtube-transcript
title: YouTube transcript
